basis: Source-audited final-policy payload/peak bounds; historical single-layer maximum-context runs used anonymous full-stack resident reservations. Matching final-runtime maximum-context tests are pending; no full-model allocator measurement.

sliding_attention.policy: Selected hybrid policy TP-decode base; excludes EP-prefill experts and additional shared decode weights. Not an actual TP-only prefill allocation.

full_attention.policy: Selected hybrid policy TP-decode base; excludes EP-prefill experts and additional shared decode weights. Not an actual TP-only prefill allocation.

full_stack_per_device.policy: Selected hybrid policy's TP-decode base for additive accounting, not actual TP-only prefill memory; see current_default_policy for the complete selected default.

assumptions: 32x32 BFP8/BFP4 tiles occupy 1088/576 bytes including exponent storage; each is already 64-byte aligned.
All 30 layers and 262144 absolute paged tokens retained; no sliding cache truncation. B1 maximum context does not imply 32 simultaneous maximum contexts.

8 MiB per layer covers retained norms, replicated router, two position tables and small metadata tensors. Expert BF16 originals and packed BF16 setup copies are released after each constructor returns; source proof is in memory_audit.md.
Embedding/LM-head allowance is one shared tied BF16 tensor replicated per device, not two separate copies.
RoPE allowance assumes prefill and decode tables shared across layers of each attention kind: two kinds times two layouts times cos/sin. Per-layer copies would exceed capacity.

Long fresh prefill retains tile-aligned chunks and merges32-way groups, releasing old groups before final nonaligned slice. Full-length input, retained outputs and final output total3*262144*2816*2=4429185024 bytes; independent2GiB reserve remains.
2 GiB reserve remains for trace regions, chunk-local workspaces, allocator padding, semaphores and unmodelled runtime overhead; no measured allocator peak is claimed.
Normal full-stack scheduling releases previous-layer full outputs and setup containers. Retaining diagnostic outputs or caller weight copies changes the bound.

Historical hybrid/shared candidates ran both layer kinds at 262143+1 with anonymous full-stack resident reservations. Matching final-policy maximum-context tests are pending. This evidence tests payload capacity and layer workspaces, not real full-model allocation order or fragmentation. No supported-context reduction.

setup_transients_per_device.lifetime: One layer constructor. Conservatively adds the superseded device BFP4 gate/up allocation to the previous combined BF16 temporary bound while the raw host-packed replacement is uploaded. In selected hybrid mode prefill_gate aliases the replacement, so the old quantized tensor is not a resident copy. CPU packing buffers are outside these per-device DRAM bounds; other small setup/allocator overhead remains in the separate reserve.

hypothetical_dual_expert_layout.description: Selected hybrid EP4 prefill plus indexed TP4 decode experts; legacy section name retained. This subtotal excludes additional optimized shared decode weights.

optimized_shared_decode.basis: Retained BF16 prefill matrices plus raw host BFP4 gate/up for both layer kinds; decode down is BFP8 sliding/BFP4 full. Each gate or up or down matrix has 88*17 tiles.

hybrid_shared_candidate.scope: Historical earlier hybrid/shared candidate: both real layer kinds at 262143-prefill+1decode with anonymous other-resident DRAM. Retained measurements are not final a12a913c acceptance or a full-model compute/fragmentation measurement.

current_default_policy.description: Selected EP4 prefill plus indexed TP4 decode experts; raw host BFP4 sliding TP gate/up and BFP4 TP down, retained BF16 shared prefill, BFP4 shared decode gate/up with BFP8 sliding/BFP4 full down.
current_default_policy.validation: Both layer kinds pass262143+1 and262144+0 with anonymous full-stack resident reservations on current runtime; not full-model allocator/fragmentation measurement.
